slides.title: I lost my keys every morning until I built a launch pad
What's a launch pad?
slides.body: One spot by the door where everything you need to leave lives. Keys, wallet, bag, headphones. Out the door in 30 seconds.

slides.title: Wall key hooks right by the door
slides.body: Keys go on the hook the second you walk in. If it's more than one step away, it won't happen.

slides.title: A catch-all tray
slides.body: Wallet, sunglasses, earbuds. A tray makes it a spot, not a pile.

slides.title: Over-the-door organizer
slides.body: For bags, dog leash, reusable totes. Vertical storage means your floor stays clear.

slides.title: A small 'outbox' basket
slides.body: Returns, library books, stuff for a friend. If it has to leave the house, it waits here, not on the counter.

slides.title: If it doesn't have a home by the door, it lives in the couch cushions now.
